overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the Commission meets only in a quasi-judicial capacity, which is exempt, so it owed no minutes. Requests for other records were left to the Public Records Law.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to provide meeting minutes in response to January public records requests.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, because the Commission has not held any meetings other than those in its quasi-judicial capacity, and because those meetings are exempt from the requirements of the Open Meeting Law, we find that the Commission did not violate the Open Meeting Law by failing to provide the complainant with meeting minutes.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Commission failed to provide meeting notices, information, and other records requested in January.
allegations.key_passage: Accordingly, we limit our review to the request for minutes, only.
